sessionOpenScope: bundled model read and SHA verification, options, native session creation/optimization
timingScope: session open separately; cold and warm recognizer inference+CTC include tensor allocation/close; image/preprocess excluded; kernel reuses one exact native output
allocationScope: per measured lane-thread Java allocation samples; median is per lane; excludes main/native threads and native arenas; caller CPU excludes ORT workers, process CPU includes them
summaryScope: upper median for even pipeline/kernel sample counts; every lane and batch observation is retained
memoryScope: whole-process Linux RSS/HWM, heap and direct-buffer pools; includes JIT/libraries/allocators; not isolated native-memory accounting or an RSS cap
collectionScope: explicit GC only after common frozen-output validation and after session closure; pipeline idle before close has no forced collection
